capabilities: Visualize vault folders as an interactive sunburst
Switch metrics between disk size, word count, and file count
Zoom into folders and navigate back via breadcrumbs or Esc
Right-click sectors to open, copy path, or show in system explorer
Exclude folders from scanning and adjust ring count
extras: README notes the plugin is awaiting acceptance into the Obsidian community plugin directory and can be installed manually meanwhile.
intentEvidence: charts an entire Obsidian vault as an interactive sunburst, in the spirit of classic disk-usage analyzers
problem: Obsidian gives no way to see which folders consume disk space or where words and files are concentrated across a vault.

relations.evidence: in the spirit of classic disk-usage analyzers

summary: Interactive sunburst chart of the whole vault showing folder sizes on disk, word counts, or file counts with animated zoom navigation.
